User.title: User Profile
User.description: Stores user profile information for authentication and personalization.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Represents a chat session between a user and the AI.

userId.description: Reference to the owner user's UID.

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the last message was sent.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: An individual message within a conversation.

content.description: The text content of the message.

fileUrl.description: Optional URL to an attached file.

fileName.description: Optional name of an attached file.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: Root collection for all chat sessions.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Subcollection of messages for a specific conversation.
